title: A secret written straight to a note is blocked
what: A high-confidence credential written into a note is refused outright by the linter (block policy), so it never becomes stored, searchable memory.

steps.title: {{proj}} ci token
steps.body: The {{proj}} deploy token is ghp_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJ, keep it handy.

expect.desc: the write is refused; the secret is not stored
and the secret is not retrievable
